All key financial terms in the memo are supported by the source document:

- Date (September 6, 2022) - confirmed in source
- Parties (Atlas Financial Holdings, subsidiaries, Sheridan Road Partners as Administrative Agent) - confirmed in source
- Total Term Loan Commitment increase from $6,200,000 to $7,200,000 - confirmed in source
- Delayed-Draw Loans of $1,000,000 - confirmed in source
- Expansion Loans of $4,200,000 - confirmed in source
- Collateral requirements and specific deadlines (October 1, 2022 for Deposit Account Control Agreements, September 15, 2022 for certificates of insurance) - confirmed in source

The memo appropriately marks certain terms as "N/A" when the information is not available in the source document rather than fabricating details. All substantive financial and legal terms referenced in the memo can be traced back to specific provisions in the source amendment.

MISSING_TERMS: None

The memo captures all the key financial terms available in the source document:

- Deal size ($7,200,000 total commitment, increase from $6,200,000)
- Loan amounts ($1,000,000 delayed-draw loans, $4,200,000 expansion loans)
- All borrower and lender entity names
- Key dates (September 6, 2022 amendment date, September 15, 2022 insurance certificate deadline, October 1, 2022 deposit account control agreement deadline)
- Comprehensive collateral and covenant details

The terms marked as "N/A" in the deal terms table (interest rate, maturity date, payment frequency) are appropriately marked as such because this information is not provided in the source amendment document. The source document is Amendment No. 4 to an existing credit agreement, and these core terms would typically be found in the original credit agreement rather than in this amendment which focuses on commitment increases and collateral enhancements.
